LABEL: endometrial lymphatic vessel
Definition: A lymphatic vessel that is part of the endometrium. Endometrial lymphatic vessels participate in tissue drainage and immune cell trafficking, with lymphangiogenesis occurring during different phases of the menstrual cycle under the regulation of vascular endothelial growth factors.

LABEL: villous mesenchyme
Definition: A mesenchyme that is part of a chorionic villus. The villous mesenchyme forms the connective tissue core of the chorionic villus, supporting fetal capillaries and the overlying trophoblast layers.
